card.name: Auxiliary verbs in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Auxiliary verbs such as HAS, HAVE, BEEN and BE in ALL-CAPS label text, right after a reaction or event noun. Typical phrasing is 'X HAS BEEN REPORTED' or 'X HAVE OCCURRED'.

modes.label: HAS/HAVE after event noun
modes.description: The verb HAS or HAVE follows an adverse event or condition named in capitals.
modes.example: ABORTION, PREMATURE BIRTH, BIRTH DEFECTS, OR UTERINE RUPTURE. UTERINE RUPTURE<< HAS>> BEEN REPORTED WHEN MISOPROST

modes.label: BEEN/BE or other capital-letter endings
modes.description: BEEN, BE or the ending IVE appears later in the same all-caps verb phrase.
modes.example: ALL CASE FATALITY RATE ARE IN THE RANGE OF 20 TO 30%, BUT RATES AS HIGH AS 70% HAVE<< BEEN>> REPORTED IN THE PAST. THERE

card.writes: It promotes upper-case token continuations, so the model keeps writing in capitals.
card.plain: It marks the verb in a capitalized warning sentence such as 'HAS BEEN REPORTED' and keeps the text in capitals.
